fitted_parameters: NONE (zero free parameters; all values are tabulated physical constants or flagged REFERENCE_NOMINAL best-practice anchors)
honest_limitations: Overlapping-sphere phi_c=0.2895 (=> ~70.8 wt% Zn) is a LOWER BOUND for spherical zinc DUST; real marine specs load 80-92 wt% for network redundancy, galvanic throwing power, and eventual Zn-corrosion-product barrier. The model gives the physical floor, not the operating point.
Zinc FLAKE / lamellar zinc percolates at LOWER loading (higher aspect ratio) -- same aspect-ratio physics as the flake-tortuosity barrier axis; not captured by the equal-sphere estimate.

Practical galvanic-series potentials are REFERENCE_NOMINAL; real free/polarized potentials shift with pH, oxygen, temperature and polarization (throwing power). Only the thermodynamic FEASIBILITY & ordering are defended.
No measured EIS / galvanic-current or accelerated-immersion data was used; field service-life is NOT claimed (that requires measured data => blocked).

tier_b_consistency_anchors.interpretation: bare-percolation is a physical LOWER BOUND; marine specs load ABOVE it for network redundancy + galvanic throwing power + eventual Zn-corrosion-product barrier.

new_axis_justification: grep of all 66 signed receipts + 30 prior AUDIT axes for zinc|galvanic|percolation|cathodic|sacrificial|electrochem|potential => ZERO hits. Every prior axis models the BARRIER mechanism (transport/FFV/tortuosity/permeance/uptake/adhesion/Tg/cure/CTE/formulation). Zinc-rich primer sacrificial protection is the single largest missing marine anti-corrosion mechanism (SSPC-Paint 20, ISO 12944-5 the dominant marine primer class).
non_circularity: The exact identities (Tier A) use ONLY tabulated physical constants; none is fitted to, or derived from, any coating performance measurement. The percolation threshold is a pure geometric invariant, independent of the galvanic thermodynamics. The marine spec window is used ONLY as an external direction check (predicted bound < spec min), never as a fit target.

real_input_data.note: Primary inputs are public-domain physical constants and published marine standards; no proprietary or rights-restricted dataset is used.

They set the CONSISTENCY / magnitude scale only; the Tier-A EXACT identities (driving force, Nernst limit, Faraday capacity, percolation identity, wt<->vol inverse) depend on tabulated physical constants alone and on NONE of these nominal values.

target_capability: Open the SACRIFICIAL (galvanic) marine protection mechanism -- zinc-rich epoxy primers -- orthogonal to every prior BARRIER-mechanism receipt. Decide (a) thermodynamic feasibility of Zn sacrificing to protect Fe, (b) whether a given zinc loading percolates into a sacrificially-active network vs remaining barrier-only, (c) areal sacrificial charge capacity.
